review: All 31 images were visually inspected for player, product, subset and visible serial or parallel.
Every image key resolves to exactly one entry in the official Topps checklist imported in version 10i.
Images are labeled reference because they are manufacturer promotional mock-ups, not exact physical-card scans.
Where the finish name is not legible or absent from the source title, the label states Promoción or only the visible serial instead of guessing a parallel.
No reverse images were available from these source pages; backs remain pending.
Image files are loaded on demand instead of being pre-cached, limiting service-worker installation weight.
